title: Report hides money but not line text from a user without financial access
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154719 Viewer) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • {User-B}'s role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154719 No Money) has Reports and Invoicing & payments - View on and See Financial Data off.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154719 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154719 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod"), Description (for example "excessive play") and the tech story (for example "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • {Work-order-1} was completed and invoiced by an Admin as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Read the rate, amount, tax and average cost cells on the same row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: a Customer Invoice file downloads.
  • Step 6: the ItemDescription cell is not masked: it reads the full line text (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • Step 7: the rate, amount, tax and average cost cells are masked: they show no money amounts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R10, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board shows the report masking; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-013; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R10: “For a user who cannot see financial data, the downloaded report masks its money columns (rate, amount, tax and average cost) as it does today. The line text is not a money value and is not masked, so the same words reach every reader of the file.”
  • Tech plan FR-013: “Report money masking unchanged; line text never masked; report stays gated server-side by `ROLE_INVOICE_VIEW` (S3-R10, prerequisites).”
